in_marathi.name: Chaitan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight, Joy, Pleasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitanya means 'delight', 'joy', or 'pleasure'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Chaitanya is a manifestation of God, known for spreading love and devotion among people. This name is believed to bring happiness and joy in one's life.
